veranderings.blok: Vier soorte dinge om na te kyk
veranderings.rede: The two joined nouns should match: the first has no article, so the second should not either.

veranderings.blok: Vier soorte dinge om na te kyk
veranderings.rede: Trees growing close together is idiomatically 'dig opmekaar'; 'teen mekaar' suggests leaning against each other.
